# Duta (دوتا — https://duta.ir) — پلتفرم هوشمند تجمیع، خوشه‌بندی و سنجش اعتبار اخبار فارسی

> Duta ("دو نگاه، یک حقیقت") is an intelligent Persian news aggregation, multi-source event clustering, and automated fact-checking/credibility scoring platform.

## Core Capabilities & Methodology
- **Multi-Source Jaccard Clustering**: Automatically groups related Persian news articles within a 6-hour window using normalized token Jaccard similarity (>= 25% overlap).
- **Bayesian-Inspired Credibility Scoring (0–100%)**:
  - **Verified (تأیید شده: 80–100%)**: Covered independently by multiple high-credibility outlets.
  - **Under Review (در حال بررسی: 50–79%)**: Single source or awaiting independent corroboration.
  - **Unverified (نامعتبر: <50%)**: Low-credibility source without independent verification.
- **85/15 Personalized Feed & Local City Prioritization**: Combines 85% user-selected categories, followed sources, and local city news (31 Iranian provinces/cities) with a 15% high-credibility discovery quota.
- **Live Market Tablo (`/tablo`)**: Real-time IRR/Toman exchange rates (USD, EUR, AED, GBP, TRY), Gold & Coins (18K Gold, Emami Coin), and USDT with ring-buffer SVG sparklines.

## Public API & Sitemap Endpoints
- `GET https://duta.ir/sitemap.xml`: Google News XML Sitemap (48-hour `<news:news>` window + 30-day archive).
- `GET https://duta.ir/api/articles/hot`: Top 4 Hot News of the last 24 hours.
- `GET https://duta.ir/api/articles/newspaper?page=0&size=20`: Representative clustered news feed.
- `GET https://duta.ir/api/articles/slug/{slug}`: Detailed article and cluster metadata.
- `GET https://duta.ir/api/clusters/{clusterId}/articles`: All independent sources covering a news cluster.
- `GET https://duta.ir/api/prices/tablo`: Live currency, gold, and crypto prices with sparkline history.
